sophie: Quick brainstorm — putting together a slim "Pilot Onboarding & Success Pack" for recruiting the next LP/design partner cohort. Need alignment on recruitment pitch, onboarding steps, incentives, telemetry/privacy options, and clear success/exit gates. Short replies please.

matt: timeline? want to start outreach next week.

elaine: I'll sketch onboarding checklist. Proposed short flow:
```
1) Kickoff call (20-30m) to set scope
2) Provision API keys + dashboard access
3) Drop starter prompt set + eval harness (we run baseline)
4) Enable telemetry (opt-in) and cost dashboard
5) Weekly 30m sync x4, then fortnightly
```
Is that tight enough?

jordan: For incentives: small credit + prioritized engineering hours. Quick tiers:
- Short pilot (6w): $3k credits + 3hrs/month eng time
- Deep pilot (10w): $8k credits + 6hrs/month + infra priority
Also define "active" = attend >= 75% syncs + upload eval traces.

legal-bot: Legal flags: NDA + DP addendum. Must surface: permitted log use, default retention 30d, opt-out for on-prem telemetry. Will post template.

sophie: Good. We should avoid hard hosted SLAs for pilots. Suggest "target SLOs" in docs and only promise firm SLA for Dedicated deals.

georgia: To reduce friction, I'll make a one-paragraph recruit blurb and a weekly note template. Template headline: "Week N — wins / regressions / asks / blockers".

matt: Ownership: PMs author playbook content, Sales owns customer comms, Legal signs contracts. Add RACI table in SOP.

sophie: Exit/graduation rules? propose: auto-close after min term unless extended; early terminate if partner misses 2 syncs w/o notice; graduation requires security checklist + cost forecast + rollout plan.

action items:
- @elaine: write onboarding SOP draft (2 business days)
- @jordan: finalize incentive matrix + "active" definition (2 days)
- @legal-bot: drop NDA + addendum (EOD)
- @georgia: recruit blurb + weekly template (1 day)
- @matt: draft SLO language for Sales (2 days)

sophie: I'll consolidate into a single playbook and run a 20m finalize sync Friday. Thanks everyone.
